parse_text: Buxcoow-will. The frats of earth and minerals, in the parts adjacent to Buxton, are peat-mols, blue clay, iron, and coal, mixed with filpular and brazzl. The warm waters there, as preferers are the ban, which takes in federal water-franges; St Am’s well, a hot and cold spring riding up into the fame receptele, and Ilgham-well.
